subject: Kickoff: Vendor payment setup & invoice flow for BrightField Labs
content:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sid Patel <sid@brightfield.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Vendor payment setup & invoice flow for BrightField Labs

Hi Sid —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. I wanted to kick off vendor setup so we can make sure your invoices are paid on schedule once work starts. A few quick items to confirm so we can complete onboarding: 

- Bank method: ACH preferred, but we support wire. Which does BrightField prefer?
- Remittance email: what address should we send remittance advices to?
- Invoice submission: do you want to send invoices to an email (AP inbox) or via SFTP/portal?
- PO requirement: do you require a PO from Redwood for every invoice, or only for invoices over a threshold?
- Payment terms: confirm your standard terms (NET30, NET45, etc.).

Attached are: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (fillable), ACH-authorization-template.xlsx, and our PO instructions (redwood_po-instructions.pdf). Please return the completed onboarding form and a signed W-9. If you'd rather, we can send a secure DocuSign for bank details — let me know.

Proposed next steps:
1) You return the onboarding form + W-9 or sign the DocuSign for ACH.
2) Once Laura confirms bank validation, we’ll create the BrightField vendor record and note PO thresholds.
3) Ben will follow up on the project SOW / estimated timing so we can align the first PO.

Can we aim to have the paperwork completed by Friday, Nov 27? If that timeline doesn't work, propose an alternate date.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf), ACH-authorization-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), redwood_po-instructions.pdf (application/pdf)

---

From: Sid Patel <sid@brightfield.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@brightfield.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor payment setup & invoice flow for BrightField Labs

Thanks Vanessa —

Great to get this moving. BrightField prefers ACH for recurring vendor payments. Please send remittance notices to accounts-payable@brightfield.com. I’ve attached the signed W-9.

Bank details: for security we prefer to provide account/routing via DocuSign (we’ll use the link you suggested) — we can also provide an ACH letterhead from our bank if you need extra validation.

Invoice rules: please route invoices to accounts-payable@brightfield.com with the PO number in the subject line. BrightField requires POs for all vendor invoices that exceed $7,500. Standard payment terms are NET30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise agreed in the SOW.

I’ve attached: W-9_BrightField_signed.pdf (signed). We’ll complete the vendor_onboarding_form and return it by Thursday. If you want to schedule a quick call to confirm the PO process, I’m available Thu 11/26 morning PST.

Best,
Sid Patel
Finance Operations | BrightField Labs
sid@brightfield.com

Attachment: W-9_BrightField_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor payment setup & invoice flow for BrightField Labs

Vanessa —

Couple of operational items from treasury/finops perspective:

- Bank validation: we usually require either (a) micro-deposit verification or (b) a bank letter on letterhead confirming the account and routing. If BrightField prefers DocuSign for transmission, we will accept that plus a bank letter for one-time validation.
- PO policy: Redwood requires a PO for any invoice > $10,000 by default. If BrightField's threshold is $7,500, we can make an exception and document a $7,500 PO threshold on their vendor record. Please confirm if that threshold is firm.
- Payment runs: we process vendor payments on T+30 schedule (net terms), with runs on the 1st and 15th of the month for ACH. If an invoice is received without a PO when one is required, payment will be delayed until PO is issued and the invoice re-submitted.
- Invoice format: we prefer a PDF with a visible invoice number, date, remit-to address, and PO number. We can accept email submission to accounts-payable@redwood.com or SFTP if they prefer batching.
- Taxes: please confirm W-9 is completed; if BrightField is not US-taxable, we will need a W-8BEN or equivalent.

I’ve attached our PO instructions for vendor-facing teams.

Thanks — I’ll standby to validate bank details once we receive them securely.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_po-instructions.pdf (application/pdf)

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sid Patel <sid@brightfield.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor payment setup & invoice flow for BrightField Labs

Sid —

Thanks for the quick replies and for returning the W-9. Confirming the agreed items below so we have a single source of truth: 

- Payment method: ACH (BrightField preference).
- Remittance: accounts-payable@brightfield.com.
- PO threshold: BrightField requires POs for invoices > $7,500. Redwood will set the vendor record to reflect a $7,500 PO requirement. (Internal note: Laura, we captured exception from standard $10k threshold.)
- Payment terms: NET30 from invoice receipt; Redwood runs ACH on the 1st and 15th.
- Invoice submission: accounts-payable@brightfield.com (PDF preferred) with PO # in the subject line. SFTP available as an alternative if BrightField wants a batch workflow.
- Bank validation: we will send a secure DocuSign link for ACH details and accept a bank letter if provided. Vivek — please advise if we should require micro-deposits in addition to DocuSign for this supplier.

Next steps: 
1) Sid to return completed vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf or sign DocuSign for ACH (Sid said Thursday 11/26 — if that slipped, please return as soon as possible).
2) Laura will validate bank/account info and create vendor record once validation is complete.
3) Ben will open the HubSpot deal (BL-8721) to capture SOW and estimated first PO; he’ll coordinate a kickoff meeting with BrightField on the SOW details.

Target: first payment run after vendor record and PO workflow are established; expect earliest payment in the 1st payment run following validation (likely mid-December).

If that all looks right, I’ll mark this thread as onboarding in our vendor tracker and send the DocuSign link for secure ACH collection.

Thanks everyone —
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
